_comment: Art-direction overrides for A Good Man Is Hard to Find. The director picks set+cast from the beat CLASS, so story moments it reads as 'question'/'neutral' lost their characters (the climax played as the narrator alone in a classroom) and 50 of 66 concrete-location scenes got the wrong set. Rules are ordered: FIRST MATCH WINS, so the most specific locations come first and the abstract/analysis beats fall through to the director's own choice.
_thumbnail: The scaffold defaulted to action:celebrate + motif:risingBars + expression:happy + hook=title — a cheering figure and a rising bar chart on a collection about a family being murdered. Recast as the Grandmother mid-reach (the story's one tender gesture, answered with a bullet) and the hook is the video's payoff, not the title.
